nom: TULA So Polished Exfoliating Sugar Face Scrub

avis.texte: I love her. I literally have a new face after using her. My only thing is it dissolves too fast and I feel like I use the bottle so quickly.

I have very sensitive skin and was looking for a gentle exfoliating scrub. This was recommended by a sales associate at Ulta. I've used numerous other products by this company and decided to give it a try. What I noticed first was the amazing scent. I love it. Second, this sugar scrub is gentle but does a wonderful job of cleaning and exfoliating my skin. I'm using it twice a week. My skin feels so soft and smooth afterwards. Best of all, no reaction to this product. Highly recommend.
My face is so soft after using this. I've tried this one and the "So Poreless" and I like this one a bit more.
This exfoliating cleanser did not make my skin feel clean nor like it scrubbed dead skin off definitely do not recommend.

I love TULA products. I thought this would be a great scrub for my clogged pores and dead skin cells from my menopausal face. It dissolves too quickly. It does scrub for a second but then it dissolves like regular sugar. It's too late to return it so I'll finish it, but I won't buy again. I could honestly get more of a scrub out of sugar from my pantry.

avis.titre: Disappointing, could not get over the smell ￼
avis.texte: This scrub does exfoliate and dissolve, however the smell is unpleasant. I do not smell anything of fruit or beach as the description states. I think if you like the smell of it, you're going to like the product however I will not be buying again.
I simply love, love, love how it dissolves into a silky texture signifying I've done my job

Unfortunately this did absolutely nothing to exfoliate my skin. It dissolves super quickly and the smell is like artificial pineapple, both of which were a bit disappointing. Not impressed, unfortunately I think its not worth the price.
I love this scrub! It smells amazing. My face feels refreshed every time I use it.
Smells so good. Love the way my face feels after. Gental exfoliant.
This is the best sugar scrub that I have ever used. If you have never tried the Tula Sugar Scrub you should because you will not be disappointed. It is the best on the market.

avis.titre: You have to use it a bit differently …
avis.texte: So is you apply this on wet skin it will dissolve almost immediately. I perfer to just aff a little water to my hands and then apply to my face. This way it feels exfoliating and doesnt dissolve as quickly. I have bad acne and always thought this helped my skin. Ive never broken out due to it. It leaves my skin glowy and soft.

Great scent and nice initial texture, but it dissolves way too quickly. It provides effective exfoliation for just a second before disappearing almost immediately. I really wanted this to work because Tula is one of the only brands that doesn't irritate or cause breakouts on my skin.

I have reallllllly sensitive skin so was scared to try an exfoliater. I kept getting milia and did some research to determine that i need a gentle exfoliater to get rid of it. I tried this one and LOVED it. Its so gentle and i use it 3x week. It keeps the milia away and makes my skin so soft. It smells tropical which is nice.

Apparently after this I found out I was alergic to papaya. Ive broken out in hives on my face and ears. Even my palms are ichy. Been days and its still there but getting better. Stay away if you sensitive skin. I've used this brand before wirh no issues
Must have . I have this product on auto delivery. I can feel the difference when I don't use it. It really softens my face up
I don't see anything outstanding, I feel this is pricey for the amount. don't think I'll buy this at full price again but enjoy the smoothness of my skin immediately after use.

avis.titre: I love the feel of the su
avis.texte: I love the feel of the sugar exfoliating my skin. It is a fantastic product . I truly love my Tula products.
Love the way exfoliating stub. It works gentle on your skin making your skin smooth n refreshed.
Leaves my skin feeling super smooth but dries out my face definetly need to moisturize after and is a little ruff but my afce feels so smoothe
I love this product. Brightens my skin, and does not cause breakouts
I have sensitive skin and I love this stuff. This has to be my 3-4 bottle. Obsessed

avis.titre: I love this product, second time I bought it
avis.texte: I recommend Tula products, specifically this exfoliant that is so good for my face, it cleans all impurities and leaves soft my skin.
I've been using this product for years and will continue to use it.
I love this stuff a couple times a week in between my mask regiment!

Usually I am not a fan of face scrubs just because of how harsh they can be, but this scrubs melts into your skin without being too rough. It smells amazing and is a recurring purchase for me. A little on the pricy side, but I think it's worth it.
I always come back again to buy this product! It has a great texture and consistency and leaves my face feeling soft, smooth, bright, and gently exfoliated.
Literally the best facial exfoliate scrub I've ever had!! I have super sensitive skin and this has by far exceeded my expectations!!

… it is the closest you will get in their current product line. I loved the So Poreless product the much more, I think it exfoliates so much better than any other but it's been out of stock for nearly 4 or 5 months at least and looking discontinued at this point and the So Polished one is a totally different texture but it still leaves my face nice and smooth

I just got this and I love it! Dare I say it's better than the expensive exuviance face polish! My face felt sooo clean! I absolutely love this face scrub. I literally love everything I have purchased from TULA!
I LOVE this product the only exfoliator that is the right amount abrasive however it is very expensive and a smaller volume wish it was bigger for the price! Still would reccomend.

This smells like a tropical vacation! Pineapple and cocnut. The sugar scrub is so fine yet it cleaned my oily skin so well. I finally feel like my face is clean. I have very oily skin and the buildup was becoming an issue. This is the answer!!!
Finally a scrub that actually has some grit to it. After washing it off, your skin feels so soft. The smell is heavenly and my blackheads on my nose have definitely minimized since using it.

avis.titre: Great Addition to My Skin Care Routine
avis.texte: Great exfoliator for the face, not too harsh. I use this about once a week and love the smell. :)

avis.titre: This item is great! I am
avis.texte: This item is great! I am 60 and I have searched my entire adult life for a great facial cleanser
Love this scrub. Gentle yet gets the job done. Smells great. Has really helped my dry skin.

avis.titre: Bought a travel size to t
avis.texte: Bought a travel size to try it out first. Loved it so just bought a full size. It's gentle enough to not be irritating, but exfoliates and brightens skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product agin.
avis.texte: Worked great for my eczema skin. Love the entire line. I have several products from this line and has worked for me. I usually stick with Estée Lauder but decided to try something different—Rated Right at the Top!

avis.titre: Exfoliant sugar scrub - great quality but a very small tube
avis.texte: I like the ingredients, especially not using orange for the critic acid. I was looking for a exfoliant with natural and safe ingredients for pregnancy which also doesn't include sunflower seed oil nor orange so I'm very pleased with the ingredients list. The only downside is the tube is so small. It would be nice if you sell this in a bigger tube so I won't ran out so quickly.
Amazing product!! Wish the Christmas scented vanilla one would come back though!

avis.titre: Finally A Scrub for my Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I took a chance and ordered Tula's scrub knowing I would probably be disappointed. Well there was no disappointment my sensitive skin loved it! I had no rash or irritation..thanks Tula!!

avis.titre: I would never buy this product again nor recommend it
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this and I immediately broke out in hives. I had about 30 bumps all over my face and my cheeks were swollen. It was almost like an allergic reaction. My face is STILL recovering. It's been five days and I'm so dry and my skin is destroyed. I do not like this product at all and cannot recommend it to anyone and would never recommend Tula as a brand. AVOID!!!! If you have sensitive skin, DONT DO IT.
This makes my skin so smooth and was recommended by dermatologist. Have been using this for years
I use this before my cleanser and it leaves my skin looking clean and feeling smoother. Highly recommend if you got oil skin.

I got this product based on the reviews but it does not work as an exfoliant product. I tried it with minimal water involvement and it dissolved every single time way too quickly. I would start on my forehead and within maybe 3-5 seconds before i could move down my face, it was a oil like texture with no grain. My skin did not feel clean afterwards or smooth.

I absolutely love this. Smells amazing and gently exfoliates without being too harsh. I have oily acne prone akin anc does not irritate and I can use daily. Also helps foundation glide on smoother. A++ highly recommend and i dont leave many reviews!
Smells so GOOD!!! And is the perfect gentle exfoliant for my face. It leaves it smooth and helps get rid of any of my dead skin

avis.titre: Sugar scrub is a must! My
avis.texte: Sugar scrub is a must! My face feels so soft after using it!!

I was using super goop sunscreen daily and it was causing millia and breakouts. I was having trouble getting rid of the millia with everything else i tried. This was the only thing that helped quickly! I used it 2x a wk for 2 wks and my millia was gone and my skin felt sk soft.
I have sensitive skin and this works great for me. I use it in the shower a few times a week and love how the sugar dissolves as you rub it on your skin.
I love this exfoliator. feels so nice on my skin and the sugar easily sinks into your skin. i feel so clean after
First 30 seconds are great but then feels like your adding a think layer of product on and need to use another face wash to clean your face afterwards.

avis.titre: Was ok but not my top 5
avis.texte: I personally didn't like the texture it was very thick and gooey and i felt like it didn't clean my face the way other ones do.
Works so well! Leaves my skin so soft and It truly feels clean!
I love Tula, but this was my first time trying the sugar face scrub. It was not harsh on my skin, but still did a great job exfoliating. Makes my skin look and feel great!
This makes my skin feel so soft! I use it 3-4 times a week. And the smell! Smells like I am at the beach! Which is a great thing!
I love this product for the texture and smell. It makes me feel so clean!

avis.titre: Only exfoliator I will ever use!
avis.texte: I've been using this sugar scrub after the Krista Horton one sold out and I LOVED that one so much I was so sad to see it go! So I decided to try this one and I love it just as much! It leaves my skin super soft, clean, and refreshed! The only thing I would change is the smell, it really doesn't have much of a smell and I absolutely LOVED the smell of the Krista Horton one but other than that I love it and won't use anything else!

So late last year I received this scrub in a monthly beauty box… I'd never paid much attention to my cleansers as I had several very good ones. So either, or, right ? WRONG. As I rubbed this into my face and felt the sugar melt into a beautiful milky froth I was shook. The scent… I can't describe it, very light but ethereal. I'd buy it in perfume form, forever…Hint hint. So after I ran out, I looked for it but didn't have the name, and many to choose from. I received the cult favorite and was enjoying that… but I wanted this one … went online, read the descriptions…. YAY ! I used it this morning… It's a lovely day.:hibiscus: If you've not tried this cleanser yet…. It's not at all harsh… the tiny bits of sugar melt in 5-7 seconds, and it becomes this magic cleansing elixir, that smells like paradise… The fact that I've gotten this excited about a face wash is huge… try it !
I love how this scrub feels on my skin. It is very soft, yet I still feel like my skin is getting extra clean.

I have sensitive skin and most scrubs are too harsh for me. I tried So Polished and am in love! It's just enough 'scrub' that my face feels polished yet its not harsh. It smells sooo good too. I now have this on auto-delivery.

My favorite scrub from TULA! Thick and gentle formula but a little goes a long way. Amazing scent and texture with instant results. Recommended 2-3 times a week but my combination skin stays rejuvenated with once a week. My mother also loved it!
Best scrub ever, and smells amazing. A little goes a long way. This will be my 3rd time purchasing.
Probably one of the best sugar scrubs I've used. I use on my hands too :-)
I've had to return most Tula products due to scent. I love this product- has a great scent and is a nice light scrub. Not harsh at all.
I look forward to using this every few days. The smell is divine and it makes my face feel so refreshed!
I love this scrub. It starts off feeling like sugar and quickly melts into your face. It smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling great. I wish it was in a larger size!!

definitely another one of my tula favorites! it does a wonderful job exfoliating without over irritating your face. you will feel the scrub pieces but quickly goes into a smooth moisturizing texture. SMELLS AMAZING! i tend to leave it on a bit and only use once or twice a week. it is definitely a must try!
The smell alone is 5 stars! Love how it makes my skin feel after using. Great addition to my skincare routine!

I love this stuff, but the last bottle I got had balls of the scrub in it. When trying to squeeze it out it got stuck and when it eventually came out it went flying along with the product. This happened 2 more times, so I actually lost snout 1/4 of the product just trying to get it out. I feel that it should be in a tub like the moisture.
Not sure if I shouldn't keep it in my shower, but the sugar kept clogging up the hole of the tube. I could barely squeeze any out and the tube was half full. Other than that, it was okay. Just okay.

I love this scrub. The feeling of it as well as the scent are fantastic. I wish everything Tula sold had this scent, or at least a line of tropical scented items! My skin was also extremely smooth after this.
Had to discontinue use after one time because of a allergic reaction

You've gotta try this scrub! Absolutely amazing. Makes your skin feel so soft and smooth. Makes your face a great blank canvas for when your going to do makeup , highly recommend. My new go to face scrub!

This is the second time I have purchased this, when I ran out of the sugar scrub I didn't want to be without it, love how easy it is to use. You don't need very much at all, also love the smell. I use this as my second cleaner on face and also helps with the exfoliant.
Love this, skin feels so soft. I definitely see a more smooth appearance. Plus it smells fantastic
Absolutely love how my face feels so incredibly soft after using this product. I'm so glad I bought it!!
I'm in love with this scrub! The exfoliating beads and so gentle and dissolve to let you know you're done. It make my face feel brand new every time I use it!

It has transformed my skin. I get small, small "bumps" along my cheeks and jawline but you can only feel them not really see them. This scrub has transformed my skin. I use it 2-3 times per week and wow yes love!
I received a bottle of this in my Allure box and fell in love with it, and so did my husband. I had to purchase more just for him. It really works and is worth every penny.
Love this product. It is not too rough on the skin but leaves your skin feeling smooth.

I reviewed this with 3 now I'm changing my mind to 4 stars. I think you have to use a bit more of the product for a gentle exfoliation. It feels nourishing on my skin and this last for a bit. It's expensive but I have enjoyed trying this product.
Very gentle scrub, would not damage your skin. I used this after the cleanser at the end of the day, and I loved it.

You almost have to use this without a wet face because the sugar dissolves when wet in a second before you can exfoliate. It leaves your face feeling nourished for a bit. It's expensive and small but you have to use a substantial amount.
I love the way this scrub makes my skin feel after. Not to mention, it smells wonderful.

Love the product! And not sure if it's only me, but the packaging is difficult to get the product out to use. I have to squeeze the tube so hard to get the tiniest amount of product to use. Again the contents of the packaging is great and I love the scrub, just hard to use.
My skin literally feels like butter after using this scrub. I use it about 1-2 times a week depending on how my skin is feeling and I swear it never fails to make my skin so soft.
Love this scrub, I won't use a different one. Love how it scrubs then melts and doesn't dry my skin out.
I love this scrub. I have sensitive skin and can't normally use a scrub but this one is fantastic and smells amazing! I use it weekly to keep my skin looking polished.
